scope: Same-day second scope: verify exported existing CAII alignment bundles against pinned source data, including residue selection, rigid transform, coordinates and receipts. No new protein modeling or biological claims.
inclusion_criteria: Primary data-representation papers supporting model provenance/interchange; official file-format and Python hashing/JSON documentation supporting implementation behavior.
Publication discovery restricted to 2022-01-01 through 2026-10-20; older existing foundations retained without repeating the round-1 review.
exclusion_criteria: Protein design/watermarking, drug discovery and unrelated experimental applications.
Broad reviews not needed for the bounded implementation; no claim that a provenance format validates the correctness of this code.

searches.query: ("protein structure"[Title/Abstract]) AND (reproducibility[Title/Abstract] OR provenance[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/10/20"[Date - Publication])
searches.pagination_policy: Bounded first 10 only; remaining 21 not retrieved or screened.

limitations: The initial query was bounded at 10 of 31; the review is not exhaustive.
Single-reviewer title screening; only the included update had abstract/full-text appraisal.
This is a new implementation scope on the same date as round 1, not elapsed-time surveillance.

supplementary_sources.claim: SHA-256 provides a digest of input bytes; no claim that an unsigned digest authenticates the sender.
Keyed message authentication is distinct from the unkeyed receipt hashes used here; no HMAC implementation added.

supplementary_sources.claim: Use bounded inputs and explicit handling of duplicate keys/nonfinite values.
Preserve fixed-width atom identity, occupancy and B-column values when checking derived coordinates.
